about.summary: I’m Hanan, but you can call me Nabi 😊 I’m a machine learning and backend developer. I studied software engineering at Arba Minch University and completed the KAIM program where I built multiple real-world ML and data science projects. I enjoy building intelligent systems that solve real problems.

projects.title: Sales Data Analysis System
projects.description: Exploratory data analysis on sales data with visual insights and business recommendations.
projects.longDescription: Comprehensive analysis of sales patterns, customer behavior, and revenue trends using Python data science stack. Generates actionable insights through statistical analysis and visualization.

projects.title: Credit Risk Modeling System
projects.description: Machine learning model for credit risk assessment with evaluation metrics.
projects.longDescription: Built and evaluated machine learning models for credit risk prediction using real financial data. Includes data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model comparison.
highlights: Used in Bati Bank buy-now-pay-later pilot

projects.title: Fraud Detection
projects.description: E-commerce and credit card fraud detection. Data cleaning, EDA, feature engineering, scaling/encoding, and imbalance handling. Model building, training, and evaluation with stratified CV; baseline Logistic Regression vs. Ensemble (XGBoost/RandomForest); metrics saved and models persisted.
projects.longDescription: Repository for e-commerce and credit card fraud detection. Includes data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, scaling/encoding, and handling class imbalance. Models are built, trained, and evaluated using stratified cross-validation. Baseline Logistic Regression is compared with ensemble models (XGBoost, RandomForest). Metrics are saved and models are persisted for deployment.

projects.title: Brent Oil Event Analysis
projects.description: Full-stack data science project for Brent crude oil prices, combining Bayesian change point detection, event impact analysis, and a modern dashboard for stakeholders.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive project analyzing Brent crude oil prices. Combines Bayesian change point detection, event impact analysis, and delivers results in a modern dashboard for stakeholders.
